title: This is my biggest AirPods complaint, and it’s not necessarily about the hardware
snippet: AirPods are one of Apple’s most interesting products. The demand for them was largely invented by the fact that the company removed the headphone jack 10 years ago, and now most of us carry this almost magical pair of earbuds that do so much more than just play audio. AirPods offer best-in-class noise cancellation, and also serve as a hearing aid. They get better and better almost every year. title: ‘Avengers: Endgame’ is the biggest movie ever again, 7 years later—and it says a lot about the future of Hollywood’s IP machine
snippet: Disney’s 7-year-old ‘Avengers: Endgame’ just grossed $126 million in a rerelease and retook the box office crown from ‘Avatar’.
